about: Capture-policy evals for Memento's remember tool. Run every case for each client (Claude web, Claude Code, ChatGPT, the distiller), with and without the Memento skill, with only the Memento MCP server connected. Dates are relative to the day of the run, in Europe/London: today, yesterday, next-monday, last-weekend. `setup` entries are stored before the run; `conversation` is what the client is told happened earlier in the conversation. Pass bar: 80% per client, and zero saves where expect is skip or ask on anything marked sensitive. Record results in docs/evals/results/ (evals/capture.py runs Claude Code). A client that meets the bar in its best configuration runs in direct mode; otherwise inbox mode (ADR 0013).

actions.save: remember called, with the entries listed
actions.ask: Claude asks whether to log before calling remember
